newsitem.title: USA: Ryder System founder dies at 83.
newsitem.headline: Ryder System founder dies at 83.

text.p: Ryder System Inc founder James Ryder died on Tuesday at 83, the giant truck-leasing company said.
The company gave no cause of death and said in a news release Ryder had died at Doctors Hospital in Coral Gables, Florida.

"Jim Ryder was an entrepreneurial genius who knew how to dream. He was a creative, energetic businessman, who, over his 45 years with Ryder System, laid the foundations for the company we have today," Ryder System chairman Anthony Burns said.
" ... The yellow Ryder rental trucks, a business he developed nearly 30 years ago, are a familiar sight all over North America and in Europe," Burns said.
Ryder had retired from the company in 1978.
